scope: TienKung DEX EVT2 29-motor reference; site hardware is not yet identified

robot_model_and_serial.evidence_required: nameplate, serial number, and vendor hardware revision

firmware_and_drive_versions.evidence_required: vendor version report from the actual robot

operating_system_and_ros2.evidence_required: target computer OS, ROS2 distribution, RMW, and bodyctrl_msgs package version

motor_count_can_ids_and_joint_names.evidence_required: read-only status capture proving all 29 IDs and physical joint correspondence

joint_zero_offsets_and_directions.evidence_required: vendor calibration and supported-joint direction test

mechanical_and_software_limits.evidence_required: hardware-specific vendor limits; simulation XML is not sufficient

imu_mount_and_frames.reference: official code consumes euler yaw,pitch,roll and body angular velocity
imu_mount_and_frames.evidence_required: static orientation and controlled-axis calibration capture

base_velocity_estimator.evidence_required: vendor or validated estimator topic, frame, latency, and accuracy

foot_contact_and_force_estimator.evidence_required: vendor or validated contact/force source used by READY and handoff checks

parallel_ankle_hardware_and_calibration.evidence_required: mechanism revision, calibration, units, ordering, and conversion failure test

motor_command_semantics.evidence_required: vendor confirmation of units, update rate, limits, watchdog, and lower-level PD semantics

exclusive_control_ownership.evidence_required: vendor-approved procedure proving only one command publisher controls each motor

hardware_estop_and_protective_stop.evidence_required: on-site test of physical E-stop and vendor protective stop/recovery

mechanical_support_and_authorized_operat.evidence_required: approved support rig, clear test area, spotters, and named authorized operator

prohibitions: Do not stop or replace the vendor controller automatically.
Do not run two motor-command publishers concurrently.
Do not treat simulation limits, identity offsets, or identity IMU rotation as robot calibration.
Do not use zero torque as a generic emergency stop.
Do not allow an LLM to alter control authority, gains, limits, or joint commands.
